channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bill Fitch | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bill Fitch from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cedric Maxwell on Kevin Garnett, Bill Fitch
item.description:
former Celtics forward Cedric Maxwell told the Boston Globe on Thursday.

“He was Kevin Garnett before Kevin Garnett. Kevin always said it was us against them, and with Bill Fitch it was us against them.”

Cedric Maxwell on Kevin Garnett, Bill Fitch, Feb 4, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: John Lucas on Bill Fitch
item.description:
Mark Berman:John Lucas on the late Bill Fitch:

“I was really sad. That guy taught me coaching.1st of all he saved my life. He’s the 1st coach that told me no more when I was going thru my problems. I always tell him he saved my life. He always told me a lot of people r mad at him for doing that”

John Lucas on Bill Fitch, Feb 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Bill Fitch
item.description:
Rick Noland:Pop on Bill Fitch entering HF:

“It's way, way, way overdue. When something like that happens, everyone breathes a sigh of relief because he did such a great job -and not just in one place”

Gregg Popovich on Bill Fitch, Apr 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.
